evidence.text: Consistent with the supported national programs for statistics, the Operation includes incentives in the form of Disbursement-Linked Indicators (DLI) milestones for timely dissemination of statistics, e.g., according to advanced release calendars, in a user-friendly format, e.g., through setup of one-stop-shop data portals and translation into local languages.

extra_evidence.text: Similarly, DLI milestones incentivize advocacy and statistical literacy, e.g., outreach programs, communication strategies, infographics competitions and literacy training.

It will also support Strategic Objective 6 under Pillar 2 to equip and operationalize a public Data Science Campus to facilitate data access, promote innovation, and build capacity in data science and big data analysis.
This involves equipping the campus with specialized technology and software, as well as developing new workstreams in training and research.
In addition, the Data Science Campus will expand partnerships and advocacy initiatives to connect members of the NSS and the wider public to the data revolution.

A regional National Accounts System (NAS) compilation software will be developed to facilitate implementation Page 22 of 151 The World Bank Eastern Africa Regional Statistics Program-for-Results (P176371) of the regional NAS guidelines by providing in-built instructions and methodological guides to compile timely and reliable national accounts.

The subcomponent on upgrading of IT and statistical infrastructure will include acquisition and training of compatible software for the Partner States in the areas of price statistics and National Accounts.

The second DLI will contribute to statistical literacy and improve dissemination and use of statistics by supporting digital Page 24 of 151 The World Bank Eastern Africa Regional Statistics Program-for-Results (P176371) dissemination through online portals and dashboards, inclusion of gender-, disability- and spatially disaggregated statistics as well as improving the timeliness of statistics by using advanced release calendars.
Finally, the sixth DLI will include the setup of emergency observatories, rapid phone survey deployments and big data analytics to create capacity to monitor and track emerging crises in real-time.
This will also generate data sets on climate change impacts and enable better sector planning for climate change adaptation (see also below).

The Operation supports development of communication strategies for major data collection initiatives (e.g. for the Population and Housing Census in Tanzania) in implementing countries and developing data dissemination tools to broaden access and use of data by citizens.
The program and its monitoring arrangements emphasizes citizen engagement.
